The '''STAP Emissary''' was a [[Hoverbike/Legends|hoverbike]] model produced by [[Longspur and Alloi]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Longspur STAP Emissary was first added to [[BioWare]]'s [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' on [[November 17]], [[2015]] as one of the items in the Force Alliance Pack on the Cartel Market.
